display.title: Parshas Shemos: The Secret of Tehillim
display.summary_short: The last letters of the first words of Parshas Shemos spell 'HaTehillim': Hashem prepared the cure before the galus began, and Tehillim can still bring us out of galus.
display.summary_long: A parsha talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Parshas Shemos opens with the names of Yaakov's sons coming to Egypt, and the Sages point out a secret in its first words: their last letters spell 'HaTehillim'. Uncle Yossi explains that Dovid HaMelech wrote Tehillim with Ruach HaKodesh, which is why its words are so holy and powerful and why so many chapters are part of our daily davening. Jews have always turned to Tehillim in good times and hard times. He urges children to memorize some chapters and say them while walking, biking, skating or waiting for the bus, quoting the pasuk that Hashem sends angels to guard us on our way and the Tzemach Tzedek's words that if we knew the power of Tehillim we would never stop saying it. Just as Hashem gave the cure before the slavery in Egypt, saying Tehillim and getting friends to say it will help bring Moshiach.
display.lesson: Fill every spare moment with Tehillim; it is Hashem's cure for every hard time and helps bring Moshiach.
